objective: Define CozyMode Core Loop as a setting-independent low-pressure Personal automated-play experience using APM-01 delegation and APW-03 bounded Activity/Project primitives, with hard human/GM/budget/stale/consent stop conditions and no-AI fallback.
design_findings: CozyMode is setting-independent low-pressure interaction, not a genre or hidden rules modification.
Initial Cozy Solo host is Personal context with explicit controller/delegation/preferences.
Core loop is orient, choose focus, confirm bounds, execute bounded operation, evaluate stop, meaningful decision, summarize, continue/change/pause/exit.
Preference profile covers focus, pace, interrupts, budgets, presentation and optional AI without widening legality/authority.
Background execution is opt-in/activity-specific with hard stop conditions and zero automated real-money budget.
Wall-clock time is not game/activity time by default.
Advancement, hidden investigation truth, human consent and GM-required NPC responses remain protected decision boundaries.
Crafting automation requires explicit recipe/reservations/budgets and stops before substitutions/new costs.
Creative/journal output remains nonauthoritative; summaries distinguish committed state from generated flavor.
Notifications are sparse/noncoercive and no streak-loss mechanic is mode-owned.
Save/exit/resume/recovery uses ordinary state/status evidence and cannot duplicate progress/spend.
Core mode remains usable without AI.
Personal automation authority does not transfer into Campaign context.
next_action: Open bounded APM-02 governance PR, run exact-head AIOC repository-health, merge after PASS, then close APM-02 and select CSW-03.
